workspace.rootPolicy: Fresh packaged Create defaults to the existing Astrid ${HOME}/.astrid-data support root. Attach preserves the catalog UUID and registered absolute realm root without copying; existing source checkout .astrid-data or explicit absolute ASTRID_RUNTIME_DATA_ROOT is resolved through storage_root and recorded once. Actual UUID/root inventory remains unresolved.

observation.referencePolicy: Unavailable references are null with an explicit unavailable reason; never fabricate task/attempt IDs.
observation.nextActionPolicy: Effects must match command contract; read-only reconciliation cannot authorize new attempts, targets, spend or paid fallback.

observation.problemCodePolicy: These normalized diagnostic codes do not replace Runtime error codes; retain raw Runtime code and failure boundary. Unknown progress/terminal/freshness stays unknown.
observation.processPolicy: No Runtime, Worker, engine or provider starts. Bounded read-only observer/helper subprocesses are permitted; no bootstrap, provisioning or state writes.
